facets.label: Reason
facets.value: The quote’s logical analogy structure (I believe X as I believe Y) satisfies an analytical, precision-oriented mind, while its core visual metaphor—faith as the light by which everything else becomes visible—maps directly onto a strongly visual cognitive style. Most importantly, it articulates religious conviction not as blind acceptance but as an epistemological anchor, which aligns with both devout belief and the overriding need for security as a foundational value. Among 100 quotes surveyed, this was the only one that simultaneously addressed faith, visual reasoning, and structured argumentation.

facets.label: Decision subject label
facets.value: “I believe in Christianity as I believe that the sun has risen: not only because I see it, but because by it I see everything else.”
